standard_prerequisites: S5 frames as reflexive and euclidean models, and the frame-definability unit's theorem that a formula true at a world in a reflexive and euclidean model is true at a world in a universal model.
The unit proposition that universal validity is decided on finite universal models (prop:univ-fin of this unit).
Every universal model is reflexive and euclidean.
core_obligations: S5 has the finite model property: if A is true at a world in some S5 model then A is true at a world in a finite S5 model.

The chain: move from the reflexive-euclidean model to a universal model (characterization), then to a finite universal model (the filtration through the subformulas of A, per the unit proposition), and observe the finite universal model is itself reflexive and euclidean.
proof_roadmap: Three-step composition across two cited results plus one observation about the universal class; the filtration through the subformula set is the explicit finite witness.
difficulty_reason: Short corollary, but the direction bookkeeping (true at a world versus valid, and the round trip through the universal class) must be kept straight.
